dct_description_sm: From Netherlands Government surveys between 1893 and 1909 ; Published July, 1914, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Includes conversion table, abbreviations, navigational text, authority information.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, islands, dranage.
Stanford copy includes hand drawn drainage and "route of explorers," with additional towns indicated.
